findings.summary: The replay guard binds the bytes of an archive, not its session. A re-extraction of a sealed session keeps the same features but gets another sha256. Every run of scripts/collection.py audit saves a new audit_<stamp>.npz, and features/snapshot.py retazec stores trvanie_s, the processing time of each snapshot measured with time.monotonic(), in that archive. For such an archive tcn.pecat.kontrola answers not_sealed, and safeguard.runtime.replay_archive replays it. safeguard replay --archive and tcn.porovnanie replay use the same check. SEALED_RULE says 'the seal binds the session, not only the bytes of its archive', but only zapis enforces this. scripts/collection.py does not use tcn.pecat. A byte-identical re-save is refused, because numpy writes the same bytes. This does not refute the criterion: SEALED_RULE also says an archive the ledger does not hold is not sealed, proposal 10.1 binds the ledger to the archives' hashes, and no session is sealed before G5.
findings.evidence: PYTHONPATH=<tree> nice -n 19 /home/eh/projects/hyptcn3/.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp <scratch>/pt -s /tmp/claude-1000/-home-eh-projects-hyptcn3/9a8a89c1-0c71-4e83-9fec-bd4ea2021d22/scratchpad/g0/ov_praca/sondy/test_sonda_overenie.py (it uses the ledger and sealed fixtures of tcn/tests/test_pecat.py, with tcn.pecat.KNIHA and ZAZNAM pointed at the test's ledger) gave {'original_sha256': '494cee5f464d5b6ad5d0e66af90b708f4e046f2ff81ad5a8af8a33bf479e7bda', 'identical_resave_sha256': same, refused with Zapecatene, 'reextracted_sha256': 'f3e04f474fe5cccde890c912a9d1a4aec4fe33cdadad337945125ad8400f923a', 'arrays_that_differ': ['trvanie_s'], 'decision_allowed': 'not_sealed', 'decision_sealed': false, 'replayed_rows': 24} and 8 passed. The tracked ledger's sha256 a54fe177... was the same before and after. The code involved: features/snapshot.py:632,635 (the trvania are measured with time.monotonic()), features/archive.py:32 (trvanie_s is saved), scripts/collection.py:1955,1995-1998 (audit_session extracts and saves audit_<stamp>.npz; the file never mentions pecat), tcn/pecat.py:713,731-733 (kontrola looks up only the file's sha256) and tcn/pecat.py:124,637 (zapis refuses 'a re-extraction' as the same session).
findings.suggested_fix: Before G5, bind the guard to the session. One way: audit_session refuses, before save, a session whose session_id the ledger seals in plan mode campaign outside the final run, as kontrola_snimok already does for its raw snapshots. Another way: the ledger also keeps a hash of the archive's feature arrays without trvanie_s, and kontrola compares it. Either way, add a test like this probe.
